title: Lecturer on Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology
bio: Dr. Armen Balabanyan is a clinician and educator specializing in general dentistry, implant and digital dentistry, temporomandibular disorders, dental sleep medicine, and esthetic dentistry. A diplomate of the American Board of Dental Sleep Medicine, he is recognized for his expertise in oral appliance therapy. He earned his Doctor of Dental Medicine (DMD) degree from Boston University’s Goldman School of Dental Medicine. He received his first dental degree from Yerevan State Medical University, where he also completed a General Practice Residency. Balabanyan serves as an instructor at the Harvard School of Dental Medicine, the Goldman School of Dental Medicine at Boston University, and Tufts University School of Dental Medicine, where he mentors the next generation of dental professionals. He is an active member of the American Dental Association, the Massachusetts Dental Society, and the American Academy of Dental Sleep Medicine.
